kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انهلكت (form VII)
# اِنْهَلَكْتُ (inhalaktu) /in.ha.lak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# اِنْهَلَكْتَ (inhalakta) /in.ha.lak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# اِنْهَلَكْتِ (inhalakti) /in.ha.lak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# اِنْهَلَكَتْ (inhalakat) /in.ha.la.kat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
